reviews.text: Never leave your four-legged children there. They lost Drac, and his family never heard from him again. They had him off-leash for a walk, and he escaped. They didn't notify the owners until 24 hours later. And to top it all off, I just saw a post on their Instagram about it. According to them, Drac (a toy poodle) was on a leash and struggled, scared by another dog, and escaped. That story is for idiots. They ruined a family.

For me, they've always been incredibly kind and attentive, taking great care of our pets. I met them three years ago and I've continued to go there, especially Elena, who's my mini poodle's groomer. Her professionalism and kindness make me feel completely at ease. Mac and his team in Santa Amelia have created an ideal place for our furry friends 🐶

The best dog groomer and daycare in Barcelona, ​​Elena treats my dog ​​as if he were her own with great care and dedication, and makes him look handsome. A true professional who clearly has a passion for what he does.
You should be ashamed of yourselves, where is Drac? Justice for this family who are going through a terrible ordeal!

I wouldn't take my dog ​​here, as they've lost a dog and their attitude hasn't been very helpful. Besides not notifying me until 24 hours had passed, they let him run loose when he shouldn't have. I've read other comments and they're horrifying. Be careful with your pets 🙌 I hope Drac turns up! …

A dog has gone missing at this boarding facility. Look it up in the news; his name is Drac. They didn't notify the family until 24 hours had passed, and then they didn't even help with the search. Search for "dracperdido" on Instagram.
Irresponsible, awful people… Drac's family is devastated. We will fight to have this facility shut down. They have no values, no empathy. They prevented him from being found. What they've done is outrageous! Justice for Drac!

Never trust them!! They let the dogs run loose, they get lost, and you never see them again. Leaving them with them, or tying them to a lamppost, is the same thing. Please, if you love your dogs, don't leave them there.

WHAT HAVE YOU DONE WITH DRAC?? I would never leave my dog ​​in your hands!!! 😢😢😢😢😢😢😢😢😢😢😢 Are you sure he's lost? Are you doing anything to find him??? Are you covering the costs of spreading the word and mobilizing resources??? …

After hearing Drac's story, I wouldn't think twice about NOT leaving my dog ​​here.

- They lost a dog during one of their walks, where they were supposedly keeping an eye on the animal.

- They notified the family 24 hours after the loss, 24 hours in which Drac could have returned to his family, as those are crucial hours to find him before anyone takes him (because he's a highly sought-after breed, a Toy Poodle).

- Instead of rectifying the situation, helping the family, issuing a statement, etc., they tried to whitewash this as a mistake. Excuse me, but the life of an animal is not a mistake, IT'S NEGLIGENCE.

You say you have a "passion for dogs." Where is that passion? If you commit such an act and the first thing you do is wash your hands of it? I find it very shameful of you.

I can only give my opinion about the doggy daycare on Santa Amelia Street in Barcelona. My dog, Soca, has been there several times and has separation anxiety, but he's always been delighted. He comes back happy, they send me photos of walks and him playing with other dogs, and they've adapted to everything I've asked of them!
I'm absolutely thrilled!

Drac's family, this cannot remain like this. We will file a legal complaint and if the center continues to fail to provide an explanation, we will make sure they close down. The power of the networks is enormous!!!
Something's happened this year; many dogs are being mistreated and lost... Change of management? That's strange.

It's unforgivable that you take your dog and they lose it. I find it absolutely heartbreaking. They lost a dog and didn't inform the family until 24 hours later. The little dog is still missing. This is unacceptable.

Passion for dogs??? YOU'RE NOT SHOWING IT!! YOU'RE REVEALING YOURSELVES!!
I've followed the case of the dog that "got lost" under your "protection" with a heavy heart, and what's most alarming isn't just the loss, but the absolute indifference you're showing.
Instead of helping and collaborating, your attitude is cold, distant, and worryingly disinterested.
Your only interest is... raising money? You're certainly not demonstrating any passion or responsibility for dogs. You have absolutely no empathy for animals!!!
They supposedly lost a puppy that was under their care, but they aren't doing anything to find it, as if they don't care.
I would never take my dachshund there; apparently, they have very little care and supervision of the pets! WHERE IS DRAC???

They say a dog has gone missing from this boarding kennel and that they aren't helping with the search. What's more, they didn't notify the family until 24 hours had passed; maybe they didn't even realize. That's not what you advertise—a passion for dogs. I think it's more a passion for money. Where is Drac?

They say their dog, Drac, is missing while they're walking him. What a terrible dog daycare. And on top of that, they're not even helping with the search... very strange... as if we should leave our furry friends there... It couldn't be worse...
It's shameful that they lost a puppy and refuse to give answers. Is that all they care about? Animals? Shameful. What have you done with Drac?

They lost a little dog, a toy poodle named Drac, while he was in their care. The most serious issue is that they only notified the family the day after he disappeared, and since then they have shown a completely indifferent attitude. They are not actively participating in the search and are treating him as if an object had been lost, not a living being with a family, a name, and feelings.

This kind of negligence cannot be justified as "a mistake." We are talking about the life of an animal and the suffering of a family. It is crucial that anyone who leaves their pet in someone's care does so with confidence, and unfortunately, this place is not safe for that.
Hopefully, Drac will be found soon, but in the meantime, hopefully, this review will make other owners think twice before leaving their animals here.

At this place, my dog ​​hadn't even been at the daycare for a day when, at 9 am on a Saturday, the man called me and said that if I didn't pay before 12 pm, he would give my dog ​​back to me as an abandoned dog. He asked for two more hours to pay. At all the daycares, even the best ones, I always pay when they return my dog ​​safe and sound. I didn't know these people worked like this. However, I told him I'd be at work at 2 pm and couldn't get back any earlier, and he said that they would treat him as an abandoned dog. Heartless people! How could I lose what I love most for a couple of extra hours to pay? And if that wasn't enough, they had put a collar around my dog's neck so tight he could barely breathe. Because of this problem, I told him I wasn't going to take him back. I left every day, hoping they would return him as soon as possible. What would have happened to my little dog? He would have died with that collar so tight he couldn't even fit a finger between his neck and the collar because they forgot to take it off and gave it to me like that. My dog ​​arrived traumatized and very scared, his eyes sad and trembling, and he couldn't walk properly, as if he had been abused 💔. The most painful thing is that if we leave what we love most, someone wants to ruin our lives for the couple of hours I asked for to make the payment. They are our children. How can a person be so cruel? I had an anxiety attack because of the psychological damage that man did to me when he told me he was going to give my dog ​​to the police as an abandoned dog. I've attached the conversation. The photo says "Mario Daycare" because that's my dog's name, but as you can see, it's the daycare's logo. Some people don't love dogs, they only love money. Very bad people.
